newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIAN SHIPPING 96 PROFIT 59 MLN EEK-REPORT.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIAN SHIPPING 96 PROFIT 59 MLN EEK-REPORT.

text.p: The Estonian Shipping Company (ESC0) posted a lower-than-expected 59 million kroons profit for 1996, the Aripaev business newspaper said on Thursday.
ESC0, in the process of privatisation, posted a profit of 59 million kroons compared to its forecast 86 million kroons profit, the newspaper added.
Chief executive of ESCO, Toivo Ninnas, was quoted as saying that the profit was lower because of extraordinary payments after the sinking of the Estonia.
The company will buy four new container vessels in 1997 to service the western Europe/Russia trade route, the newspaper said.
